answer: A payout is split so that 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The violet schedule is applied in dawn and juniper shows each instalment. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4775 identities would post 3140 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
